assets.title: 轻轻一笑
assets.alt: 不规则椭圆轮廓中的简洁笑脸
assets.prompt: Create ONE new original tiny decorative pen doodle for careKind's minimal editorial design system. Style references are the user's original Microva+ screenshots, especially the small outlined heart, balloon and smiling face, used only for their airy pen-drawing feeling. This is a NEW raster decoration, not an edit of a reference, not a UI icon or logo. Use extremely spare light single-pass fine near-black #111111 contour strokes with tiny natural irregularity, roughly 4–6 pixels wide on a 1254px square canvas. The effect must be visibly lighter and much simpler than the previously generated careKind nurse scenes and detailed hands. Single subject, only a few deliberate lines, large clear negative space, subject occupies approximately 55% of a square canvas. Genuine alpha-transparent background, including enclosed shape interiors: no white fill, paper, coloured background, shadow or gradient. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, label, additional props, realistic anatomy or intricate detail. No heavy outlines, shading, sketch doubling, crosshatching, large solid black fill, 3D or photographic rendering. Warm and mature, spontaneous and elegant, not an emoji or kawaii sticker. Designed to sit beside a serif heading at 64–128 CSS px. SUBJECT: an imperfect, gently tilted oval smiling face, just two tiny dot eyes and one shallow curved smile within one very thin oval outline. No nose, hair, ears, neck, body, blush or eyelashes. Keep the expressive character of a spontaneous hand doodle rather than a geometrically perfect emoji. No other elements.
